description: For \(c\) constants and relation arities \(r_1,\ldots,r_s\), the number of labelled tables on \(d\ge1\) elements is \(d^c2^{d^{r_1}+\cdots+d^{r_s}}\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.table_card (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ) (d : ℕ) :
  Nat.card (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.Table c arities d) =
    (d + 1) ^ c * 2 ^ (List.map (fun r => (d + 1) ^ r) arities).sum
